summary: The ChangePassword functionality includes a web interface for users to change their password with validations to ensure password strength and format.
purpose: To enable users to change their password securely while ensuring password complexity and compliance with policies.

fields.name: txtCurrentPassword
fields.description: Field for entering the current password.

fields.name: txtNewPassword
fields.description: Field for entering the new password.

fields.name: txtNewPassword2
fields.description: Field for re-entering the new password for confirmation.

workflows.name: Change Password
steps: User accesses the Change Password page.
User enters a new password that meets complexity requirements.
User re-enters the new password for confirmation.
User checks the policy agreement checkbox.
User clicks the Change Password button.
If validation passes, the password is updated.

business_rules: New password must not be the same as the current password.
User must agree to terms and policies to change the password.
validations: Require current password field to be filled.
New password must be at least 12 characters long.
New password must include digits, upper and lower case letters, and symbols.
New password inputs must match each other.
conditions: If new password is the same as the current password, an error is generated.
If policy checkbox is not checked, an error is generated.
system_behavior: Displays error messages in a panel if validation fails.
Redirects to a specified URL after successful password change.
